findings.message: Preserve InPlaceDeferred for transient kubelet resize errors. In UpdateModeInPlace, this change returns InPlaceInfeasible for ResizeStatusError, violating the supplied contract that transient errors remain eligible for reconsideration next loop. If the caller caches this result in infeasibleAttempts, subsequent checks can skip the pod even after its error clears.
findings.evidence: Lines 142–161 route ResizeStatusError in InPlace mode to InPlaceInfeasible; CHANGE.diff shows the previous return was InPlaceDeferred. Lines 127–132 return InPlaceInfeasibleCached for a recorded attempt unless RecommendationHasLowerResource allows reconsideration, before examining the current resize status. The caller that populates this map is unavailable, so actual cache insertion and persistent suppression are conditional.
